objection_receipts.evidence: The POSIX close error returns false before free(vfd); a successful close frees the wrapper and returns true. This establishes the backend's source-level return contract only.
objection_receipts.limitation: GBA unload ignores the bool and clears its pointer. No source receipt establishes real OS close-on-error descriptor state, retry safety, or recovery.

objection_receipts.evidence: The POSIX unmap body calls msync(MS_SYNC) then munmap and discards both results; the interface slot returns void. Sync is a separate bool VFile method.
objection_receipts.limitation: This source contract is not proof of durable persistence, syscall completion, physical Flash, or cold-restart behavior.

objection_receipts.evidence: Borrowed-memory close frees its wrapper without freeing the borrowed buffer; VFileMemChunk close owns/releases its mapped allocation. Memory unmap is a no-op and sync returns true without performing I/O.
objection_receipts.limitation: Does not establish allocation failure behavior, application ownership after caller misuse, or durable storage.

objection_receipts.evidence: fclose failure returns false; sync checks fwrite's element count and fflush; read/write return backend counts; map/unmap and truncate contain unchecked seek/read/write results and unmap/truncate are void paths.
objection_receipts.limitation: Source confirms only these code paths; not retry safety, every stdio implementation, or real failure/recovery behavior.

objection_receipts.evidence: VFileOpen selects compile-time backend branches (stdio, PSP2, 3DS, or fd); helper read/write functions return backend counts, with scalar reads decoding only on exact count.
objection_receipts.limitation: Does not identify which backend any downstream build selects or establish cross-platform runtime behavior.

objection_receipts.evidence: Mapped Clone checks exact output-write lengths; its VFile-backed loop ignores output-write results and returns based on input-read nonnegativity. VFile-backed Load overwrites the input-read count with output-write count and returns read >= 0; Mask/Unmask and Deinit discard selected close/unmap/load results. Clean calls RTCWrite only after data sync returns true.
objection_receipts.limitation: These are source-visible branches. RTC negative/short-read runtime behavior, allocation/map failures, complete negative I/O matrix, caller acceptance, serializer round trips, and persistence remain NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

objection_receipts.evidence: GBAUnloadROM invokes savedata unmask/deinit, discards close results, and clears realVf. Separately, GBAFrameEnded invokes savedataUpdated only when dirty transitioned from nonzero to zero during the frame; that callback carries no sync result.
objection_receipts.limitation: No full frontend/embedder execution or user-facing failure/retry behavior is established.

objection_receipts.evidence: Core deinit has a void contract. SavedataClone returns zero for no-size and failure paths, returns the cloned size on success, and ignores temporary VFile close results. SavedataRestore returns its initialization success when masked, otherwise the savedata load result.
objection_receipts.limitation: No external mCore consumer, allocation failure, API result interpretation, or full lifecycle execution is established.

objection_receipts.evidence: File state wrappers return serializer/load booleans but discard VFile close bools. Buffer save maps and copies bytes without checking map; callback macro triggers a named script callback with no persistence result; default load flags omit SAVESTATE_SAVEDATA.
objection_receipts.limitation: No real scripting engine, frontend, state round trip, or callback consumer is executed or certified.

objection_receipts.evidence: The API describes savedataUpdated as finishing modification of save data; exported SAVESTATE_SAVEDATA/RTC names are flags and do not specify serializer behavior or persistence success.
objection_receipts.limitation: Documentation/API declarations do not establish script runtime execution, RTC serialization, or persistence.

objection_receipts.evidence: VFile read/write/readline/size return ssize_t; close/sync return bool; map returns a pointer; unmap/truncate return void.
objection_receipts.limitation: Interface types do not prove implementations or that callers consume all returned values.

objection_receipts.evidence: The mCore interface declares deinit as void, savedataClone as size_t, and savedataRestore as bool.
objection_receipts.limitation: The declarations do not establish external consumer interpretation or error display.

objection_receipts.evidence: GBADestroy is declared void; the GBA structure holds ROM/BIOS/MB VFile pointers and savedata state used by its teardown chain.
objection_receipts.limitation: A void declaration bounds result reporting only; it does not establish teardown completion, ownership outside the struct, or durability.

objection_receipts.evidence: The struct declares active/real VFiles, map mode, maskWriteback, dirty age, and RTC buffer layout; APIs declare clone/load/clean/RTC and serialize/deserialize methods.
objection_receipts.limitation: State/API declarations do not prove serializer implementation, RTC round trips, or persistence.

objection_receipts.evidence: mSavedataClean clears dirty and returns true after the seen-state age threshold; it exposes no VFile result. GBASavedataClean subsequently gates RTCWrite on sync success, while GBAFrameEnded's callback predicate is only dirty transition.
objection_receipts.limitation: Source flow does not establish retry policy, external notification semantics, or durable save success.
